North Macedonia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Skopje, Macedonia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passport NO
Service/Official biometric passport NO
Diplomatic biometric passport NO
Biometric Identity Card NO
Citizens of the Republic of North Macedonia hoders of passports as well as Biometric Identity Cards are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to ninety (90) days in any period of a hundred and eighy (180) days, which means taking into account the period of a hundred and eighty (180) days preceding each day of a stay.
